name: Airport Shop Occupancy
query:
SELECT
    airport AS "Airport:Link/Airport:200",
    COUNT(*) AS "Total Shops:Int:130",
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Occupied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS "Occupied Shops:Int:150",
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Available' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS "Available Shops:Int:150"
FROM `tabAirport Shop`
GROUP BY airport
ORDER BY airport
